clips.title: The story
paras: The Dark Riders are a band of mysterious, hooded horsemen who terrorize Duskwood. Merciless hunters of magical relics, they strike from hiding and leave only slaughter in their wake.

Little is known of the Dark Riders' origins. Witnesses describe hooded horsemen who speak in voices both harsh and shrill, and one was seen using a small gem to take orders from a master it called only its 'Lord'. They hunt objects of magical power across the kingdom, cutting down anyone who stands between them and their prize.
